summary.text: Seth Haskin, a candidate with no party affiliation, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 19th Congressional District to Jim Schwartzel.
Ballotpedia lists a career as a business manager and a 2022 bachelor's degree.

paragraphs.text: Haskin earned a high school diploma from St. Croix Falls High School and a bachelor's degree from Bethel University in 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
Haskin says he comes from a lower middle-class background and holds a bachelor's degree in neuroscience, and Ballotpedia lists a career in business management.
Haskin describes the main goal of a term in Congress as increasing the size of the House of Representatives and says he supports a literal interpretation of the Constitution.
Haskin's campaign centered on increasing the size of the U.S. House and on constitutional and structural reform proposals.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Jim Schwartzel's 61.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
